no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: YD Bio Ltd is an early-stage Cayman-incorporated diagnostics + ophthalmology company that listed on Nasdaq in Aug 2025 via SPAC. Its therapeutic (LSC-derived exosome) programs for Dry Eye and AMD are still preclinical with IND submissions targeted in 2026 and Phase 1 not expected until 2027. Current commercial activity is FDA-cleared contact lenses, OTC artificial tears, and licensed LDT cancer-detection tests - none of which are P1/P2/P3 drug programs.
